svg.title: What the shopper can do with a plan: add any single ingredient or the whole plan to the cart, change quantities with the standard stepper, replace a product from a ranked list of other catalogue products that satisfy the same ingredient, remove ingredients they already have so the total updates and the plan rebuilds, and see exactly why the plan looks the way it does, with budget swaps, dropped optionals, substitutions and unavailable items stated in plain language. Example plan line: Onion, need 2 pieces, Onions 1 kg pack at 35 rupees, with alternatives Onions small pack 500 g at 22 rupees and Organic Onions 1 kg at 68 rupees. The rest of the store is a working quick commerce app: home with category rails, category and sub category browsing with sorting, search, product pages, a cart drawer, checkout with address and payment, and an order confirmation that advances through order placed, packed, on the way and delivered. Cart rules: free delivery above 499 rupees, otherwise a 25 rupee delivery fee, plus a 6 rupee handling fee.

section.h2: A plan you can argue with

ul.li: Add one ingredient, or the whole plan, to the cart
Change quantities with the standard stepper
Remove what you already have: the total updates, the plan rebuilds
